question: How did delivery revenue develop per month over the last year?
restatement: You want to see how line revenue developed per month, only for delivery (channel), over the last year.

definitions.name: delivery revenue
definitions.label: Delivery revenue
definitions.definition: line revenue of the order lines sold through the delivery channel

points.question: What should the chart say?

options.label: nothing: only name what is shown

points.why: the System 1 model was not sure (0.12 below 0.50)

result.sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', "f"."date_key") AS "month", SUM("f"."line_revenue") AS "line_revenue" FROM "fact_order_lines" AS "f" JOIN "dim_channel" AS "dim_channel" ON "f"."channel_key" = "dim_channel"."channel_key" WHERE "dim_channel"."channel_name" = 'delivery' AND "f"."date_key" >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND "f"."date_key" <= CAST('2025-12-31' AS DATE) GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', "f"."date_key") ORDER BY "month" ASC LIMIT 10000

steps.sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', "f"."date_key") AS "month", SUM("f"."line_revenue") AS "line_revenue" FROM "fact_order_lines" AS "f" JOIN "dim_channel" AS "dim_channel" ON "f"."channel_key" = "dim_channel"."channel_key" WHERE "dim_channel"."channel_name" = 'delivery' AND "f"."date_key" >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND "f"."date_key" <= CAST('2025-12-31' AS DATE) GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', "f"."date_key") ORDER BY "month" ASC LIMIT 10000

steps.label: the first half against the second
steps.sql:
SELECT CASE WHEN "month" < CAST('2025-07-01' AS DATE) THEN 'Jan–Jun' ELSE 'Jul–Dec' END AS "half", AVG("line_revenue") AS "line_revenue"
FROM (
  SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', "f"."date_key") AS "month", SUM("f"."line_revenue") AS "line_revenue" FROM "fact_order_lines" AS "f" JOIN "dim_channel" AS "dim_channel" ON "f"."channel_key" = "dim_channel"."channel_key" WHERE "dim_channel"."channel_name" = 'delivery' AND "f"."date_key" >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND "f"."date_key" <= CAST('2025-12-31' AS DATE) GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', "f"."date_key") ORDER BY "month" ASC LIMIT 10000
) AS "answer"
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
